instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct conjunction.

atoms.b: My mum compared prices ((++before or)) she bought a new TV.
atoms.finishSound: My mum compared prices before she bought a new TV.

atoms.b: Andy cancelled the date ((++because so)) she felt ill.
atoms.finishSound: Andy cancelled the date because she felt ill.

atoms.b: Tuan decorated the cupcakes ((++after or)) they had cooled down.
atoms.finishSound: Tuan decorated the cupcakes after they had cooled down.

atoms.b: Daniel played video games all day ((++although because)) he had homework to do.
atoms.finishSound: Daniel played video games all day although he had homework to do.

instruction.text: Match the sentence parts to form a sentence that makes sense.

atoms.sound: Did you bake the cake or did you buy it?
I don’t like apples, but I love apple juice.

atoms.b: and she bought a birthday present for her dad.
atoms.sound: Sarah went to the shops, and she bought a birthday present for her dad.

atoms.a: My parents made me babysit my brother,
atoms.b: so they could go to the cinema.
atoms.sound: My parents made me babysit my brother, so they could go to the cinema.
